query: SELECT cm.id as module_id, cm.title as module_title, cm.slug as module_slug, COUNT(cl.id) as lesson_count FROM course_modules cm LEFT JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.module_id = cm.id WHERE cm.is_published = 1 GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title, cm.slug ORDER BY cm.id;
